# Saabai

> Saabai (ABN 71 889 082 572) is a Gold Coast, Queensland business (head office Merrimac QLD 4226, Australia) founded by Shane Goldberg. Saabai has two products: website care plans for small businesses, and the Saabai Blueprint AI audit. All prices are in AUD. Saabai is not GST registered (GST not applicable).

## Products

- [Website care plans](https://www.saabai.ai/websites): Saabai builds, hosts and manages small business websites with an AI enquiry chatbot built in. Care plans: Presence $100/month, Growth $200/month, Signature $300/month.
- [Saabai Blueprint AI audit](https://www.saabai.ai/blueprint): a ranked AI plan showing where AI saves hours and dollars. Starter $497 (48 hours), Pro $1,497 (3 business days, reviewed by Shane, 30 min walkthrough), Business $3,500 (2 to 3 weeks, team discovery, 12 month roadmap). Fee credited if you build with Saabai within 30 days.
- [Free AI Readiness Score](https://www.saabai.ai/score): a free 3 minute, 12 question quiz with an instant score out of 100 and three quick wins.
- [AI chatbot for law firms](https://www.saabai.ai/ai-chatbot-law-firms): Custom AI chatbots and Lex, an AI workspace for Australian law firms. Capture after-hours enquiries and get alerts by email, SMS or WhatsApp.
- [AI receptionist for Gold Coast businesses](https://www.saabai.ai/ai-receptionist-gold-coast): A Gold Coast built AI receptionist for your website. Answers enquiries 24/7 and alerts you by email, SMS, WhatsApp or Telegram.
